author: Peter Grongelot

title: Careful it installs spam on your phone
body:
I installed Focus Keeper quite a long time ago and only now found out that it also install a hidden app or something called “Baby Story: Pregnancy pictures” on your phone!!
If it’s not already it should be reported and it should be illegal to install something like that without your knowledge. You can see it in your iCould apps on your phone! I don’t know what it does, but I didn’t agree to install it.
author: Autaron

title: Pomodoro effekt
body:
Fantastisk simpel app. 
Den giver virkelig bevidsthed om, hvor meget man faktisk kan nå på 25 min (når man ikke lader sig forstyrre). 
Den er god til at sørge for fokus. 
Den er uundværlig på hjemmekontoret, så man sørger for at holde pause, får skuret stilling og motioneret.
author: Repsej76

title: Keeping me in the groove
body:
This app helps me keep focus. I run 25 minute sessions. These are without any sound from the app. But the breaks are accompanied by a clock ticking to get me to actually take a break.

This enables me to keep going longer. I take a refreshing break before I get tired. Also actually being focused for 25 minutes is pretty great.

The app is well designed. Have tried so many of these, but now I have finally found the right ond.
